## Color printing from Saved Models in Windows 0.24.34

Select a model and choose **3MF · 4 filaments** to build a palette of up to four colors from its textures, vertex colors and materials. Color regions are assigned to filament slots on each triangle. Match those slots to the spools loaded in your slicer and review the purge settings for your materials. The export includes the palette and a 280 mm³ starting purge volume between different slots. Choose **3MF · full color** for a workflow that accepts 3MF textures and vertex colors. For Workbench sculptures it embeds the original texture images, their mapped coordinates, and the colored mesh surfaces.

## Color export validation, Windows 0.24.34

Exported a saved five-part owl through the gallery and Windows Save As. Independent comparison covered all 147,799 triangles, including color on the sides and back. Checked four embedded source images byte for byte, UV references, vertex colors and filament assignments. lib3mf reopened both files and read their color resources. ElegooSlicer imported the four-color export and sliced it offline into toolpaths using all four corresponding filament slots. Also checked legacy STL dimensions and the original GLB checksum. No physical print was run.

Source commit 06a17a5d150a010562dd6710d466938afb116920.

ElegooSlicer used all four owl colors in its offline toolpaths. Its paint_color attribute is a slicer extension, which the lib3mf reference reader flags while still reading the standard palette. The full-color export opened in lib3mf with zero warnings.
